english.title: Pay for exhibition of election address, bill or notice promoting election candidate
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) were guilty of an illegal practice in that you, for the purpose of promoting or procuring the election of a candidate, namely **(..SPECIFY CANDIDATE..), at an election, namely **(..SPECIFY ELECTION..), knowingly made a payment or contract for payment to **(..SPECIFY NAME..), who was

(A)_[an elector,]_
(B)_[a proxy of an elector,]_

on account of the

(C)_[exhibition]_
(D)_[use of a house, land, building or premises, namely **(..SPECIFY LAND, BUILDING OR PREMISES..) for the exhibition]_

of, an address, bill or notice
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 109(2)(a) and 169 of the Representation of the People Act 1983.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
for the purpose of promoting or procuring the election of a candidate at an election
knowingly made a payment or contract for payment to an elector or his proxy on account of the
exhibition or use of a house, land, building or premises
for the exhibition of, an address, bill or notice

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
Complex - see section 176

Note
On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
